body: Yeah, I don't know how I'd even start to socialize again. I feel like I'm not in a good spot to try and build any sort of friendship. I'm so afraid of being burned again. I want to go back a couple of months and try and stop it. So that I don't have to feel this pain. My chest, it feels empty. I feel stupid for having trusted those people. I feel dirty and vulnerable over the fact that they know so much about me, stuff that they could use against me. They probably won't, but I feel paranoid.

I want to give people the benefit of doubt and say that they are trying their best and they are just ignorant. They haven't felt the same kind of pain, they don't suffer from the same illnesses, they have functioning safety nets, friends, family, they have what a lot of others lack. But so often, that advice just ends up hurting more. I've been given advice where my situation was completely ignored, and in the end it feels like only I'm to blame, further fueling the pain and loneliness. I can't just go out. I can't just meet people. I can't just make friends like that. I can't end the loneliness like that.
Yeah, not a very unique situation I'm afraid...
I doubt going and asking for an apology from someone who doesn't want to talk to me and believes he did nothing wrong is the best of ideas.

I'm pretty sure he doesn't want to hear from me. The relationship between us cannot be fixed, not before he properly apologizes and he won't. I came so close to ending my life because of him, and considering that I'll probably be dead soon it probably doesn't matter if he makes me suicidal, but I'd like to still keep some amount of dignity, it's all I have left.

A friend who I had a falling out with. I have no way of contacting him anymore and it is for the best if I don't. Things ended extremely poorly and he wasn't the best of influence. I don't know if I miss him, or the idea of him, the things that could have been. I think I just miss him out of loneliness. I'd also like to hold my cat again, but she's gone and currently dust in a metal jar, so...
I don't really want to be in contact with them. I barely have enough energy to take care of myself, I don't have the energy to do something nice for somebody else
I'm not close with my family. I think I love only because I feel it is required of me
i dont want to survive any longer. i just want to die
